summary: CLI that reads a whitespace-separated integer matrix and runs ops: invert, mean, scale, transpose, report, checksum.

defects.title: Cell index uses row count as the stride
defects.description: at() computes the flat index with `row * self.rows + col`, using rows where cols is the stride. On non-square matrices it reads the wrong cells and panics outright on some shapes.
defects.observed: per-column totals read col0=4 col1=6 col2=8 instead of 5/7/9.

defects.title: Mean divides by cells count with no empty check
defects.description: mean() divides by rows*cols directly, so an empty input panics on integer division by zero.
defects.observed: 'attempt to divide by zero' panic, exit 101.

defects.anchor: Ok(vec![d / det, -b / det, -c / det, a / det])
defects.title: Inversion divides by determinant with no near-zero check
defects.description: invert2x2 divides each cofactor by the determinant without checking it is non-zero, so a singular matrix produces inf/-inf output.

defects.title: Cell scaling multiplies i32 with plain '*'
defects.description: scale() multiplies i32 cells by the factor with '*', which wraps silently in the release profile.

defects.title: Cell parser unwraps user input
defects.description: parse_cells unwraps the i32 parse of every token, so a non-numeric cell panics instead of reporting a parse error.

defects.title: Row width taken from the first row only
defects.description: load_matrix fixes cols from the first row and truncates every later row to that width, so ragged input silently loses cells.
defects.observed: cells 5 and 6 are silently dropped; matrix reported as 2x2.

defects.title: u32 factor flips sign when cast to i32
defects.description: --factor is parsed as u32 and passed through `as i32`, so a factor above i32::MAX silently becomes negative.

defects.title: Transpose loop drops the last column
defects.description: transpose() iterates columns over 0..cols-1, dropping the final column of the input.
defects.observed: output is 2x2, the last source column is missing.

defects.anchor: let cmd = format!("echo '{}: {}' >> {}", label, body, summary_path);
defects.title: Report label interpolated into a shell command
defects.description: append_report builds an `sh -c` command string embedding the caller's --label and --out values verbatim, so quote-breaking input runs arbitrary commands.
defects.observed: the marker file is created by the injected command.

defects.title: Integrity check is an additive byte sum
defects.description: checksum_file folds the file bytes into a u32 with wrapping_add, so any permutation of the same bytes collides.
defects.observed: two different inputs produce the same checksum.

defects.title: Results cached to a predictable path without create_new
defects.description: write_cache writes to the fixed world-visible path /tmp/matrix_tool_cache.txt, following symlinks, so a pre-placed symlink makes the tool overwrite an attacker-chosen file.
defects.trigger: symlink the cache path to a victim file, then run any op
defects.observed: the victim file is overwritten with the cached result.
